agentApprovals.incidentTitle: 🚨 P1 CRITICAL: Unix Mainframe Kernel Degradation & High CPU Spikes on Worker 1
agentApprovals.summary: P1 Outage: High kernel thread contention and memory pressure on Worker 1 (192.168.56.10). Agent proposing emergency SSH SOP execution.

agentApprovals.incidentTitle: PostgreSQL Primary Node Connection Pool Exhaustion
agentApprovals.summary: Connection pool reached max_connections limit (500/500). Proposing terminating idle connections older than 10 mins and reloading PgBouncer config.
proposedCommands: psql -U postgres -c "SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state = 'idle' AND state_change < NOW() - INTERVAL '10 min';"

safetyChecks.check: No active write transaction holding locks

agentApprovals.aiReasoning: Terminating 142 stuck idle sessions frees 28.4% database memory and lowers active connection count to 358, allowing pending app connections to resolve.

routerOutput.userAcknowledgment: Ticket INC0000015 logged for DB Cluster East. DBA Self-Healing Agent dispatched.

resolverOutput.diagnosis: Database connection pool saturated (500/500 connections) due to unclosed app connections.
resolverOutput.matchedRunbook: KB0000012: PostgreSQL Connection Pool & Vacuum SOP
resolverOutput.userNotice: Proposed database pool cleanup paused for DBA lead sign-off.

synthesizerOutput.kbTitle: SOP: Postgres Connection Pool Recovery & PgBouncer Reload
synthesizerOutput.synthesizedSolution: Issue pg_terminate_backend for idle sessions and issue systemctl reload pgbouncer.
synthesizerOutput.trendInsight: Recurring issue during peak batch jobs. Recommend increasing max_connections from 500 to 800 and adjusting app idle timeouts.
